bank.q: How does your theoretical framework integrate both valuation and governance of ecosystem services?
outline: Define ecosystem valuation and governance clearly
Explain how both concepts interact in your study
Show how this integration supports your research question
bank.pitfall: Treating valuation and governance as totally separate topics without showing how they work together.

bank.q: Since methods are not given, how did you measure land-use decisions and human well-being?
outline: Acknowledge that specific methods are not provided here
Discuss standard methods used in this field for these variables
Explain how data collection supports the main research question
bank.pitfall: Inventing specific data collection tools or results that are not stated in the prompt.

bank.q: What are the main limitations of studying the Global South as a single broad category?
outline: Discuss the diversity within countries in the Global South
Note how regional differences might affect ecosystem governance
State the boundaries of the current thesis scope
bank.pitfall: Overgeneralizing findings to all developing nations without acknowledging local differences.

bank.q: What is the primary contribution of this thesis to the study of ecosystem valuation?
outline: Highlight the focus on the Global South
Explain the link between valuation, land use, and well-being
Show how this advances existing academic discussions
bank.pitfall: Claiming to solve all global environmental problems instead of focusing on the stated scope.

bank.q: How generalisable are your conclusions across different ecological and political contexts in the Global South?
outline: Identify common patterns across developing regions
Highlight contextual factors that might limit broad application
Suggest where findings can be safely applied
bank.pitfall: Assuming that governance systems work the exact same way in every country.

bank.q: What alternative explanations could account for changes in human well-being besides ecosystem governance?
outline: Consider economic factors outside ecosystem valuation
Discuss the role of national policies and external markets
Explain how your study isolates ecosystem governance effects
bank.pitfall: Ignoring other major drivers of human well-being like poverty, health, or macroeconomics.
